lesson_1: CI workflows using merge commits with second-parent changes must use fetch-depth: 0 (full history) or ensure all referenced git objects are reachable.
lesson_2: evidence_checker validate_40hex_hash calls git cat-file to verify commit objects exist. Shallow clones (fetch-depth < full) may miss commits only reachable via second-parent chains.
lesson_3: When root cause is CI environment (shallow clone), fix the environment, not the evidence files.
recommended_process_change: Set fetch-depth: 0 for workflows that validate commit hashes in evidence packages, to avoid hash_not_found errors from shallow clones.
